events.title: Tech Triad
events.description: A three-part tech event featuring talks, a live demo, and a hands-on challenge. Open to all students curious about software, hardware, and AI.
events.desc_volunteer: Manage registration at Room 101, help set up the live demo, and guide participants through the hands-on challenge.

events.title: Build-a-thon Weekend
events.description: A weekend-long hackathon where teams ideate, build, and present working prototypes to a panel of judges. Mentors will be available throughout.
events.desc_volunteer: Assist teams at the Innovation Lab, coordinate mentors and meals, and help run judging and presentations.

desc_member: Help organise tech talks, workshops, and hackathons, and mentor participants on software, hardware, and AI projects.

events.title: Pixel Panic: Game Jam
events.description: A fast-paced game jam where teams build a playable game from scratch around a surprise theme. Artists, coders, and designers are all welcome.
events.desc_volunteer: Set up the Computer Lab 2 workstations, announce the surprise theme, and help teams with submissions and playtesting.

events.title: Retro Arcade Night
events.description: An evening of classic arcade games, friendly tournaments, and prizes. Come relive the golden age of gaming with friends.
events.desc_volunteer: Run the game stations, keep tournament brackets and scores, and hand out prizes.

desc_member: Help run game jams and gaming events, and contribute as a coder, artist, or designer on club projects.

events.title: Strings & Stories
events.description: An open-air evening of acoustic music paired with storytelling and poetry. Relax under the sky and enjoy live performances by students.
events.desc_volunteer: Arrange seating and sound at the Open Air Theatre, manage the performer lineup, and guide the audience.

events.title: Campus Unplugged
events.description: A stripped-down live concert showcasing solo and band acts from across campus. Expect covers, originals, and surprise collaborations.
events.desc_volunteer: Handle backstage coordination, stage and sound setup, and performer check-in at the Main Auditorium.

desc_member: Help coordinate music events, manage rehearsals and logistics, and perform or support acts on stage.

events.title: Open Mic: Unfiltered
events.description: An open stage for poetry, stand-up, music, and storytelling. Sign up on the spot and share your talent with a supportive audience.
events.desc_volunteer: Manage the performer sign-up sheet, keep the speaking order, and time each act.

events.title: Theatre in a Day
events.description: A one-day theatre workshop where participants write, rehearse, and perform a short play by evening. No prior acting experience needed.
events.desc_volunteer: Help groups with scripts and props, keep rehearsals on schedule, and manage the evening performance.

desc_member: Help plan open mics and theatre workshops, handle performer sign-ups, and support the stage and audience.

events.title: Launchpad: Startup Sprint
events.description: A startup sprint where teams pitch an idea, validate it, and present a business plan to mentors and guest entrepreneurs.
events.desc_volunteer: Manage team check-in, keep time for pitches, and guide guest mentors between teams.

events.title: Design Thinking Challenge
events.description: A hands-on workshop where teams use design thinking to solve a real campus problem, from empathy mapping to prototype and pitch.
events.desc_volunteer: Set up the Workshop Studio, hand out materials, and help teams through each stage from empathy mapping to pitch.

desc_member: Help organise startup and design-thinking events, line up mentors and guests, and support teams through their pitches.
